plugins.verifyReleaseCmd: test "$(gh api repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha)" = "$GITHUB_SHA" || { echo "main moved past the verified commit $GITHUB_SHA" >&2; exit 1; }
plugins.prepareCmd: set -e; git diff --quiet "$GITHUB_SHA" -- package.json && exit 0; tree="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/trees" -f base_tree="$(git rev-parse "$GITHUB_SHA^{tree}")" -f 'tree[][path]=package.json' -f 'tree[][mode]=100644' -f 'tree[][type]=blob' -F 'tree[][content]=@package.json' --jq .sha)"; release="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/commits" -f message='chore(release): ${nextRelease.version} [skip ci]' -f tree="$tree" -f "parents[]=$GITHUB_SHA" --jq .sha)"; gh api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/main" -f sha="$release" -F force=false --silent || { echo "could not fast-forward main from the verified commit $GITHUB_SHA" >&2; exit 1; }; git fetch -q origin main; git checkout -q -- package.json; git switch -q --detach "$release"
